summary: Segregated local and remote execution adds a hop node peered to the controllers and a remote execution node peered to the hop, useful for remote sites or a DMZ; groups named instance_group_* become instance groups in the UI.
questions: How do I run automation in a DMZ with automation mesh?
How do I create instance groups from the installer inventory?
Hop node example for remote execution nodes

answer_card.title: Remote execution node through a hop node
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationcontroller:vars]
node_type=control
peers=instance_group_local

[execution_nodes]
aap_e_1.example.com
aap_e_2.example.com
aap_h_1.example.com node_type=hop
aap_e_3.example.com

[instance_group_local]
aap_e_1.example.com
aap_e_2.example.com

[hop]
aap_h_1.example.com
[hop:vars]
peers=automationcontroller

[instance_group_remote]
aap_e_3.example.com
[instance_group_remote:vars]
peers=hop
```
Groups named `instance_group_*` appear as instance groups in the UI.
